records.source_Japanese: 甲板画面では、航海士の担当を決められます。
records.English: Use Deck View to assign navigator duties.
records.compiled: Use Deck View to assign navigator duties.
records.speaker: Deck View instructions / navigator filter
records.source_gloss: Choose navigators and room types to assign duties. Insufficient ability prevents assignment; higher ability improves the effect.
records.context: Ordinary Deck View/Filter cold boot. Actual line spacing is16 pixels; the previous 12-pixel model missed clipping.
records.localization_note: The instruction names the screen and its purpose in a single line.
records.current_Compiled: Use Deck View to assign navigator duties.
records.current_English: Use Deck View to assign navigator duties.

records.source_Japanese: 航海士を選んで部屋に配置すると、部屋の種類によって航海士の担当が決まります。
records.English: Pick a navigator and assign them a room. Room type sets their duty.
records.compiled:

records.source_gloss: Choose navigators and room types to assign duties. Insufficient ability prevents assignment; higher ability improves the effect.

records.current_English: Choose a navigator and a room. The room type determines their duty.

records.source_Japanese: 各担当には、必要な能力があります。能力が不足していると、担当につけません。能力が高いほど、担当を配置した効果も高くなります。
records.English: Each duty requires certain abilities. Navigators must meet them to qualify. Higher ability improves performance.
